goal: P03 extraction and Hán–Nôm uncertainty in backend/services/research_factory/

features_delivered: Document structure parsing (P03-A01): Extracts chapters, volumes, page indices, and footnotes from validated documents while enforcing strict reading order (raising ColumnReadingOrderError on scrambled/ambiguous column sequences).

Vietnamese printed OCR (P03-A02): Performs text extraction with confidence scores, bounding boxes, and diacritic preservation (raising DiacriticCorruptionError when diacritics are dropped, preventing semantic corruption of relic names like Cửu Đỉnh).
Han glyph region detection (P03-A04): Detects character bounding boxes on rubbings and stone inscriptions while rejecting surface scratches, cracks, and patina noise (NoiseArtifactDetectedError).

Han-Nom transcription proposer & uncertainty engine (P03-A05): Proposes character candidates with Sino-Vietnamese readings, normalized bounding boxes [0.0 - 1.0], and uncertainty flags whenever confidence is below 0.90.

Negative abuse defense: Low-confidence or unreviewed glyphs CANNOT auto-publish or be marked canonical without explicit human epigrapher approval and non-placeholder citation (UnverifiedGlyphAutoPublishForbiddenError).
Edition collation assistant (P03-A06): Preserves authentic historical variant readings across editions and blocks silent smoothing or unreviewed harmonization (SilentVariantCorrectionForbiddenError).
Layout locator mapper (P03-A07): Maps printed page folios (e.g. 'Tr. 14a', '18b') to digital PDF indices and flags mismatches (MismatchedPrintedPageError).
Figure and caption extractor (P03-A08): Accurately separates authentic artifact inscriptions from archive watermarks and stamps (WatermarkMisidentifiedAsRelicLabelError).
OCR quality evaluation (P03-A09): Computes CER/WER against human ground truth and rejects ungrounded self-proclaimed 100% accuracy claims (AssumedPerfectAccuracyForbiddenError).
Extraction integrity auditor (P03-A10): Builds tamper-evident ExtractionEnvelope with cryptographic SHA-256 parent lineage enforcement (SnapshotLineageDisconnectedError).
Cross-image epigraphic checks: Evaluates epigraphic congruence across 2D rubbings, 3D photogrammetry meshes, and woodblock printings, preserving stroke discrepancies.
Missing Hán–Nôm tracking: Tracks the 4 known incomplete motifs (urn_nghi_dinh_03, urn_thuan_dinh_13, urn_tuyen_dinh_11, urn_huyen_dinh_12) as missing/uncertain and requiring expert signoff.
Database persistence & pipeline integration: Full persistence into ResearchRun, ResearchPhase (P03), ResearchJob (P03-A05), and ResearchEvidenceResult.
